faqs.question: Is Scotland or Ireland better for first-time visitors?
faqs.answer: Both are excellent first trips from North America or Europe. If you want dramatic scenery and a world-class medieval city, Scotland has the edge with Edinburgh and the Highlands. faqs.question: Which is cheaper, Scotland or Ireland?
faqs.answer: They're very similar in overall cost. Scotland uses GBP (£), Ireland uses EUR (€). A mid-range daily budget in both countries runs roughly £60–85 ($75–105) per person — covering a budget hotel, meals, transport, and a couple of attractions.
